div.head: Leis Wl 18.1
div.ab: Ki abat femme a terre pur fere lui force: la munte al seinur X sol.
Ki abate femme a terre pur faire lui force: la multe al seignur X solz.
Si ui ad terram prostrauerit, ut uiolaret, domino X sol. reddat.
Ki abat femme a terre pur fere lui force, la munte al seinur X sol.
18, 1. Wer eine Frau zu Boden wirft, um ihr Gewalt anzuthun: die Mund (Geldstrafe I) an den Herrn 10 Schilling.
18, 1. Whoever throws a woman to the ground in order to do her violence: the mund (money penalty I) to the lord 10 shillings.
If anyone throws a woman to the ground in order to offer violence to her, the compensation to her lord for breach of his mund shall be 10 shillings.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 262–263 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text and German translation added from Gesetze I p. 504–505, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)

note.seg: da mulcte nicht vor 14. Jh. belegt, und L das Wort ausliess als unverständlich, vielleicht munte zu bessern
since mulcte is not attested before the 14th cent., and L omitted the word as unintelligible, it should perhaps be emended to munte
